summary: This project is an interactive, 7-page educational comic book series that chronicles the historic 15-year journey of NASA's Opportunity Mars rover. By translating dense scientific logs and mission milestones—ranging from its 2004 landing and water-detection hypotheses to its record-breaking marathon distance and final 2018 dust storm—into a structured visual narrative, the project makes complex planetary science accessible and engaging for all readers.
details: Our project is an interactive, educational comic book series and digital storytelling platform focused on space exploration, specifically detailing NASA's legendary Mars exploration missions such as the historic journey of the Opportunity rover. It combines rigorous scientific facts with engaging, panel by panel comic layouts to make complex interplanetary missions accessible and captivating for audiences of all ages.
